_comment: How each cosmetic is fitted to the 32x48 body. The items are now drawn standalone on magenta, so there is nothing to cut them out of a character - the pipeline keys the magenta, trims to what is left, and scales to a stated width. These are the numbers that decide how big a hat looks and where it sits.
_measured: The male idle front frame, row by row: the figure is 25px wide, centred on x=16. The skull crown is rows 2-10, the head widest at row 11, the neck pinches to 9px at row 23, the torso runs rows 24-38 at 21px wide, and the legs take rows 39-47. Every default below comes from those rows.

_fields.widthPx: finished width on the 32px body canvas; height follows the art
_fields.bottomRow: hats: the row the brim lands on. The skull crown is rows 2-10 but the hair sits a little proud of it, so 11 is where a hat looks worn rather than hovering
_fields.centreRow: aprons: the row the garment is centred on
_fields.flip: false for anything asymmetric, which then needs its own _back.png
